name: FineWeb (undertrained)
takeaway: Failure was undertraining, not model size.

name: Blend pretrain
takeaway: Small WORLD lets a tiny model write fluently.

name: Blend SFT (Q&A)
result: answers in correct shape, facts confabulated
mask: prompt masked; loss on answer tokens only
takeaway: Format is cheap to learn; knowledge doesn't fit.

name: Books pretrain
takeaway: Broad language backbone; near-zero reliable facts.

name: RAFT reader
mask: context+question masked; loss on answer/citation span
takeaway: Architecture sound; 42M too weak to extract reliably.

name: Vocab A/B — filtered
takeaway: Vocab filtering HURT: filters words, not world.

name: MoE throughput test
takeaway: MoE is a large-scale technique; no payoff at 50M.

name: Throughput ceiling
result: 19k tok/s @ batch 32; compile fails (no Triton on Windows); batch 64 spills to RAM (10x slower)
takeaway: Already at HW ceiling; no free throughput win on Windows/8GB.

name: LR sweep (0.5/1/2x)
result: val loss 3.672 / 3.683 / 3.710 (lower LR slightly better); benchmarks within noise
takeaway: Default LR near-optimal; not a lever. Use ppl not benchmarks for small tweaks.

name: FineWeb-Edu A/B
setup: 50M, FineWeb-Edu vs raw, 200M tok, same-run n=500
result: ARC-E +2.4, but PIQA -3.6, HellaSwag -2.4, LAMBADA -4.8 vs raw
takeaway: Net LOSS at 50M: edu specializes toward reasoning, costs narrative/commonsense. Quality-data benchmark gains need scale.

name: Gradient checkpointing
takeaway: Activations are the memory wall; checkpointing ~3.4x's trainable size. New limit = optimizer state.

name: 168M vs 50M (params lever)
result: val 3.583 vs 3.683 (-0.10); PIQA +3, HellaSwag +2.25, LAMBADA +2.75, ARC-E -2.75
takeaway: FIRST positive lever: loss down + 3/4 benchmarks up. Params move the needle where data tricks didn't. Costs 3x wall-clock, still undertrained.

name: Reasoning+logic model
setup: 151M, char-level, 200M tok synthetic CoT (13 types: arithmetic + logic)
result: 100% on 2600 fresh held-out problems (incl. transitive, syllogism, boolean, modus ponens)
mask: none — loss on all tokens (problem + chain-of-thought)
takeaway: Perfect IN-DISTRIBUTION mastery. But see generalization tests below.

name: Generalization tests
setup: reason168 on out-of-distribution: 4+ digits, GSM8K phrasing
takeaway: The 100% was PATTERN-MATCHING, not reasoning. Generalizes 0 steps beyond training distribution. Real reasoning = generalization = needs scale.

name: mix16 pretrain
takeaway: Beats GPT-2-small on HellaSwag at ~50x fewer tokens (data+arch); PIQA lags — knowledge tracks tokens. 16K vocab freed VRAM, ~2.5x throughput vs 32K.

name: mix16 SFT
result: learns format + stopping by ~step 1000; facts confabulated (Paris ok, 'capital=Toulouse' not); loss plateaus ~1.95
mask: prompt masked; loss on assistant turns only (8% of tokens)
takeaway: SFT teaches behavior/format, not knowledge. Could've run 2k steps not 6k. High-variance samples; capacity ceiling unchanged.
